notespost: I have spent a long time listening almost exclusively to East Asian music.., yet this track, ‘REMIND ME’ by Chase Atlantic, has unexpectedly taken hold of me. I cannot fully tell whether it is because something in its atmosphere echoes a feeling that pulls me back to 2019, allowing certain memories and emotions to surface again, or because the piece itself carries a distinctly mysterious, abstract, and faintly unsettling character. The sensation it evokes is difficult to articulate, but it resembles the strange contradiction of smiling while being confronted with something deeply morbid. This track will, without question, be reimagined by me in the future. The true challenge lies in discovering how this complex emotional state can be translated into the language of a symphonic orchestra, a task that feels both demanding and profoundly compelling..
The new website is finished, with a refreshed visual identity and new features. A few audio-only releases are still coming, and regular content will start from early 2026.
